hook.text_role: tells the viewer the thing they accept as normal is actually broken
hook.visual: bold text card over a close-up of the everyday problem

beats.visual: close-up of the problem happening, slightly exaggerated
montage of the problem getting worse, faster cuts
product solves it in one clean demo, steady camera
beats.line_role: the fix, with one concrete number
a person's last line, not a slogan: the brief's offer, else the product plus one dry line; never 'today', never the hook again

audio.music: tense pulse, resolves to major key at the fix
sfx: record scratch at the agitate peak

rules: roles and patterns only - no original lines, footage, audio or likeness
